pick.name: Kokoro-82M
pick.what: Small open-weight TTS that runs on CPU
pick.why: Free, offline on a no-GPU laptop, Apache-2.0 so commercial use is clean; good quality for demos.

alts.name: Google Cloud TTS (Chirp 3 HD)
alts.what: Studio-grade cloud voices incl. Indian English/Hindi
alts.why: Higher quality and Indian voices; 1M free chars/month then $30 per 1M.
alts.free_limits: Chirp 3 HD: 1M chars/month free, then $30/1M (search summary matched official page)

alts.name: ElevenLabs
alts.what: Most natural/expressive cloud voices, hosted MCP
alts.why: Pay-later pick for premium voiceover; free tier is not licensed for commercial use.
alts.free_limits: Free: 10,000 credits/mo, no commercial licence; commercial from Starter (~$6/mo)

candidates.name: Gemini API TTS free tier
candidates.verdict: free-tier data used to improve Google products; commercial terms unclear

decision: Kokoro is free, local and licence-clean. Use Chirp 3 HD (within 1M free chars) for Indian-accent or Hindi narration, and ElevenLabs Starter when a launch video needs the best voice.

verify.note: Apache-2.0, v1.0, 8 languages, 54 voices. Windows install may also need espeak-ng.
